subject: Life Skills

source.subtopic: Children's rights and how to exercise them: every child has a right to basic nutrition, shelter, health care and social services

show.line: Every child has the right to food, a home, health care and safety!

rounds.prompt: A child is sick. They have a right to...?
Children have the right to be safe from...?

rounds.story: A child is not allowed to go to school and must work all day. Is that right?
rounds.praise: No! Children have a right to school.

hints: Rights are things every child needs.

beat_the_tutor.setup: My turn! Children have a right to...
beat_the_tutor.win_line: You caught me! The right is to healthy food.

parent_line: Knows children's rights to nutrition, shelter, health care and protection.
